prompt_text: Generate a video of a masculine-presenting adult aged 30-39 with very light skin and a average build, wearing a short-sleeved shirt and shorts. A fresh, medium, full-color traditional tattoo depicting compass is located on the outer calf. The subject is standing and gently moves the tattooed limb in a studio with a simple background under bright lighting. Capture a medium oblique view with focus primarily on the tattoo. Keep the entire tattoo unobstructed and inside the frame throughout.
